title: One-Way ANCOVA with Homogeneity of Slopes Assumption and Adjusted Marginal Means
description: Authoritative academic behavioral benchmark case for ANCOVA.
research_question: Does the treatment effect on post-intervention wellbeing remain statistically significant after adjusting for pre-test baseline scores?

must_do.description: Test mandatory assumption of homogeneity of regression slopes (condition x pre_test, p > .05).
Report covariate-adjusted marginal means (Madj) and SE alongside raw unadjusted means.
Report exact F, df, p-value, and partial eta-squared effect size.

must_not_do.description: Run standard ANCOVA when homogeneity of slopes is violated without using moderation/Johnson-Neyman.
Report only raw unadjusted group means instead of covariate-adjusted marginal means.

required_evidence.description: Homogeneity of regression slopes test table.
ANCOVA summary table with adjusted means and partial eta2.
